I'm sorry that happened to you — losing a deposit like that is a horrible experience, and it's completely reasonable to want to verify who you're dealing with before paying anything.

On specifics: I don't have a business license document or a signed guarantee template I can issue from this chat, so I don't want to overpromise there. What I can tell you directly is our address (1200 Market St, 2nd floor) and the booking terms already listed — 50% deposit to hold a date, balance due 14 days before the event. For the verification documents and anything in writing beyond our chat, let me connect you with our events manager, who can send that and confirm terms directly — they'll follow up by email today.
